# Country scope. True when this human player realm can receive an era-weighted music cue.
oe_wp26_mus_can_play = {
	is_ai = no

	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_aud_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_cue_cd }

}

# Cultural/geographic realm classifiers (safe capital checks; zero unguarded nullable eq)

}
